notes: Gives a person a folder: from now on they see its files and can send into it. DELETE takes it away. Admins see every folder whatever this says; it counts again if they become members (an admin who becomes a member keeps every folder until some are taken away). PUT and DELETE /api/folders/{id}/invites/{invite_id} do the same for an open invite for a new member. Both 204, also when nothing changed; 404 not_found for no such folder, person or open invite for a new member.
